Advocate for the Respondent :
 Before
 Honourable Mr. Justice Sanjay Kumar Medhi
 Order

. 
Heard Shri N Haque, learned counsel for the petitioner, who has filed this petition under Section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure, praying for transfer of FC(Civil) Case No. 301/2024 from the Court of Sajida Jesmin vs Abdul Hashim on 14 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/117477644/
1 the learned Principal Judge, Page No.# 2/3 Family Court at Guwahati to the Court of the learned District Judge, Karimganj.
The proceeding is for restitution of conjugal life.

It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that apart from the fact that the petitioner is residing at Karimganj, the marriage was also solemnized at Karimganj and the respondent is also a resident of Karimganj, who, however, is presently staying at Dubai.

It is further submitted that for no reasons,
the proceeding has been instituted at Guwahati.

Shri Haque, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that there is a 2 years old child of the parties and in the meantime, the petitioner has also instituted a proceeding under Section 498A of the IPC at Karimganj.

Let notice be issued, returnable on 22.07.2024.
Steps for service of notice upon the sole respondent be taken by registered post with A/D.
It is seen that though the address of the respondent has been put as Karimganj in this petition, in the proceeding before the learned Family Court, Guwahati, his address is shown to be at Guwahati.

Accordingly, the learned counsel for the petitioner is required to file amended cause title incorporating both the address and steps, as directed above, are required to be taken in both the addresses.
Shri Haque, learned counsel for the petitioner prays for an interim order.

Considering the facts and circumstances, till the next returnable date, further proceedings of FC(Civil) Case No.301/2024 pending in the Court of the learned Principal Judge, Family Court at Guwahati shall remain suspended.
